description: This file contains assembly code for handling entry to and exit from regular IRQs (RIRQ) on ARC architecture within the Zephyr RTOS. It manages context switching, stack manipulation, and return from interrupts, including special handling for returning to cooperative threads and restoring register states.

methods.name: _rirq_enter
methods.description: Prepares the system for handling an IRQ, switches to IRQ stack if necessary, and jumps to the IRQ demux handler.

methods.name: _rirq_exit
methods.description: Handles cleanup after IRQ processing, manages context switch if needed, and executes return from interrupt instruction.
